test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
From the given numbers 452, 243, 361, 579 and 674, if in each number, the first and the second digits of each number are interchanged, than which of the following will be the highest number?

(Example - 697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)
solution:
Given: (left) 452 243 361 579 674 (right)

After interchanging the first and second digits of each number, we get:

524, 423, 631, 759, 764

The highest number is: 764 (obtained from 674)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
